model_system: 2D crystal supercells with topological Chern bands under (i) an external superlattice potential and (ii) a stacking-induced moire potential

key_params.observable: local polarization from semilocal hybrid polarizations (SHPs)
key_params.SHP_definition: P_beta^h(r_j,k_perp)=-(e f /Omega_0) sum_n^occ integral_0^{x(r_j)} (partial wbar_{n,beta}^h(k_perp)/partial x_{kappa,alpha}') dx_{kappa,alpha}'
key_params.supercell_geometry: Nx ax by Ny ay lattice vectors (figure indicates Lx=Nx ax, Ly=Ny ay)
key_params.benchmark_topology_tool: Wilson-loop / hybrid Wannier charge center winding vs k_perp

headline_claim: Across a topological phase transition from trivial to topologically nontrivial, the magnitude of the local polarization decreases discontinuously, but does not vanish completely.
replication_difficulty: high - requires implementing a new SHP/local-polarization formalism for Chern bands and reproducing topological supercell calculations without explicit software workflow in the excerpt.
